One book a month, each by an author from a different country. Every boarding pass carries its month's stamp: it's inked when you have both finished the book.

Book Club

The question of the month, your own columns (never merged) and the club's shared notes. Everything you write here also fills the archive, one scrapbook page per book.

Reading Room

Two bookshelves,
one we share

Each of you has a personal bookshelf for your own progress, ratings, quotes and notes, including books outside the club. The shared shelf in the middle shows the club books you're reading together, and how close you both are to each month's stamp.

    Fausto's Corner

    The club's very important cat

    Fausto is Vitória's cat and the reason this club has a name. He doesn't read, exactly, but he has opinions. His recommendations are real authors and books, from countries still blank on our map.

    Cover Manager

    Every book, dressed properly

    Every cover on the site in one gallery. Click any cover, here or anywhere else on the site, to replace it with an image from your computer or a link. You'll see a preview before saving, and you can always restore the original.

    Covers load from Goodreads and Open Library and are then kept in your browser. Covers you replace are shared with the other reader when sync is on. For offline copies, unzip the cover pack into a folder named covers next to this file.
